text: 金十数据8月28日讯，中国人民银行有关部门负责人就《关于改革完善房地产信贷管理 推动加快构建房地产发展新模式的意见》答记者问。《意见》坚持以人民为中心，加强制度规范，配合商品住房销售制度改革，重点改革开发建设和销售阶段的信贷制度，强化资金封闭管理、专款专用，更好维护购房人合法权益。在开发建设阶段，通过开发贷款主办银行对项目资金实行封闭管理。要求项目预售资金监管账户和定金账户，应按规定在主办银行开立。项目存续期间，房地产开发贷款、项目自有资金、现房销售资金等与项目相关的全部资金均应纳入项目公司在主办银行开立的资金账户管理。项目公司对外负债、投资等重大事项，
text_en: Jin Shi Data, August 28 — A relevant official from the People's Bank of China answered reporter questions on the Opinions on Reforming and Improving Real Estate Credit Management to Accelerate the Establishment of a New Model for Real Estate Development. The Opinions adheres to a people-centered approach, strengthens institutional regulation, coordinates with the reform of the commercial housing sales system, focuses on reforming credit systems at the development, construction, and sales stages, strengthens closed management of funds and earmarked use, and better protects the legitimate rights and interests of homebuyers. At the development and construction stage, closed management of project funds is implemented through the lead bank for development loans. It is required that project presale fund supervision accounts and deposit accounts should be opened at the lead bank as required. During the project's existence, all project-related funds, including real estate development loans, project self-owned funds, and completed property sales funds, should be included in the fund accounts opened by the project company at the lead bank.
